author: Trilivy Blog
title: Easy Mongolian beef recipe (ready in 25 minutes!)
ingredients: 1 cup red bell pepper, cut into strips
instructions_list: In a small bowl or a glass measuring cup, whisk together the low-sodium soy sauce, beef broth, calorie-free sweetener, minced garlic and fresh ginger. Set the sauce aside.
Heat a large skillet or wok over high heat. Add the ground beef and cook for about 5 minutes, breaking it apart with a wooden spoon, until it is crumbly and no longer pink.

Push the cooked beef to one side of the skillet. Add the broccoli florets and red bell pepper strips to the empty side. Cook for 3–5 minutes, stirring occasionally, until the vegetables are tender but still crisp.

Add the sliced scallions and the prepared sauce to the skillet. Toss everything together until the beef and vegetables are well coated in the sauce. Let it simmer for a minute to allow the flavors to meld.
Place ¾ cup of cooked cauliflower rice into a shallow bowl. Top with 1½ cups of the Mongolian Beef mixture.
description: This easy Mongolian beef recipe uses lean ground beef, broccoli and cauliflower rice for a healthier twist on a classic favorite — ready in just 25 minutes.
